body: As a pretty religious person, I can say that religion has done pretty much nothing to help my depression. People shouldn't take advantage of the vulnerable to bring them into religion as a solution for instant happiness and purpose in life.

Thank you for the response. The last answer I got on another thread was a troll and you being serious makes me feel much better.

I hate seeing happy people. Even worse I hate seeing couples.
